facts.text: Serve the snacks when Cooper and Donald sit on the porch with a beer.
facts.why: Wikipedia confirms Cooper lives with his father-in-law Donald and raises the kids with him. None of the pages I opened shows a porch beer scene.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when Cooper and Murph watch the dust storm roll in.

vibe.verdict: A warm farmhouse recipe box that nails the corn and dust, but leaves out most of the film's big ideas.
missing: Cooper's line that Murphy's law means whatever can happen will happen
Dr. Mann's planet and his falsified data
The 5,000 frozen embryos on the Endurance
ideas: Swap 'Cold sweet tea with lemon' note for 'Murphy's law: whatever can happen will happen.'
Swap 'Buttermilk biscuits with honey' note for 'Cooper's watch, set to the same time.'
Swap 'Soft pretzel bites with beer cheese' for 'Embryo egg bites' with 'Five thousand, frozen.'
Swap 'Ice planet crackling pork roast' note for 'Mann's planet, the data was faked.'
